title: Instinct Unit
description: An atomic, confidence-weighted design instinct learned across cycles. Validates the YAML frontmatter object of an instinct unit (see reference/instinct-format.md). Project-scoped units live at <root>/instincts/instincts.json; promoted global units live at ~/.claude/gdd/global-instincts.json. Persisted + queried by scripts/lib/instinct-store.cjs.

id.description: Kebab-case stable identifier, e.g. "prefer-token-over-hex". Lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens.

trigger.description: One sentence naming the situation that fires the instinct, e.g. "When a color literal appears in a component, reach for a design token first."

confidence.description: Posterior trust in the instinct. Floor 0.3 (a fresh instinct is advisory, never directive); ceiling 0.9 (no instinct is ever certain). TTL decay multiplies this by 0.9 when the instinct goes unsurfaced.

domain.description: Lifecycle stage the instinct applies to, aligned to the Phase 50 lifecycle stages.

scope.description: project = learned from one repository; global = promoted after the K/M gate across distinct projects.

project_id.description: 8-char hex sha of the normalized git origin the instinct was first learned from. Required for project scope; optional for global (a promoted instinct is no longer tied to one origin).

source.description: Which producer minted the instinct: a reflection pass, the extract-learnings step, or a direct user assertion.

cycles_seen.description: How many distinct design cycles have surfaced this instinct. Feeds the K=2 half of the promotion gate.

project_ids.description: Set of distinct project ids that have surfaced this instinct. Its length feeds the M=2 half of the promotion gate.

first_seen.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the instinct was first recorded.

last_seen.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the instinct was last surfaced. Resets the TTL decay window.

alpha.description: Beta posterior success weight. Seeded from the Beta(2,8) prior on promotion.

beta.description: Beta posterior failure weight. Seeded from the Beta(2,8) prior on promotion.

prior_class.description: Tag recording which prior class seeded the posterior, e.g. "instinct".
